info.title: Orvano Console API
info.description: The control plane API that the Orvano console calls. It ships with the server and has no SDK.

get.description: Answers whether the install still needs its first run setup, or 503 `unavailable` while the platform schema is not migrated.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

get.description: Answers 404 for an organization the operator isn't a member of.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

get.description: Lists every status, oldest first. `query` matches the name, ignoring case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 100; 50 when not sent.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; omit it for the first page.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Matches the name as a contains, ignoring case.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

post.description: Answers 201 once the project is active.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

get.description: Answers 404 for a project outside the operator's organizations.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

get.description: Lists every key, newest first, with its status. Never holds a key itself.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 100; 50 when not sent.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; omit it for the first page.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

post.description: Answers 201 with the full key, exactly once. Only its hash, prefix, and last 4 characters are stored. A secret key needs at least one scope; a publishable key defaults to every client scope.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

post.description: Makes a session and sets its cookie. A wrong password, an unknown email, and a disabled account each answer the same 401 `invalid_credentials`. After 5 failures for one account in 15 minutes the answer is 429, even with the right password.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

get.description: Answers the operator, their first memberships, and the CSRF token. 401 means signed out, and 401 `session_expired` means the session ended.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

delete.description: Ends this session at once and clears its cookie.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

post.description: Makes the operator, the organization, and a session in one transaction, sets the session cookie, and closes setup. Answers 401 `setup_token_invalid` for a wrong, expired, or replaced token, 409 `setup_complete` once setup is done, and 400 for a password the policy refuses.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

post.summary: Check the first run setup token.
post.description: Answers 204 when the token is the current, unexpired one, without using it up; 401 `setup_token_invalid` for a wrong, expired, or replaced token; 409 `setup_complete` once setup is done; 403 when the request's Origin is not the console's; 429 after 10 checks in a minute from one address.

default.description: An error. The code says which one; x-orvano-error-codes describes every code.

lastUsedAt.description: When it was last used, to the minute.

expiresAt.description: When it stops working, or null for never.

allowedActions.description: The console permissions the operator holds on it.

ApiKeyResponse.description: An API key. The key itself is never shown again.

ApiKeyStatus.description: Where a key stands, read from its dates.

setupRequired.description: True until the first owner account is made; the console then shows only the setup page.

instanceName.description: The name the console shows for this install.

publicUrl.description: Where this install is reached, or null when it isn't set.

features.description: The switches this install has on.

ConsoleConfigResponse.description: What the console needs before its first render.

scopes.description: What it may do. Required for a secret key; left out, a publishable key gets every client scope.

expiresInDays.description: Days until it stops working; left out, it never does.

allowedOrigins.description: The exact browser origins it accepts, at most 100.

key.description: The full key, shown this once.

lastUsedAt.description: When it was last used, to the minute.

expiresAt.description: When it stops working, or null for never.

allowedActions.description: The console permissions the operator holds on it.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: A key just made. This is the only answer that holds the key (spec 0017 AKY-3).

field.description: The field's wire name; in a body, a dotted camelCase path with indexes, such as `address.city` or `tags[2]`.

code.description: What is wrong, such as `required` or `too_long`.

message.description: An English sentence describing the problem, safe to show.

FieldError.description: One problem with one field of the request.

KeyType.description: The two API key types (spec 0006 KEY-1), stored as `platform.api_key.type`.

allowedActions.description: The console permissions the operator holds on it.

MembershipResponse.description: An organization the operator belongs to.

locale.description: The chosen language, or null to follow the browser.

allowedActions.description: The console permissions the operator holds on it.

items.description: The items on this page, in the list's order.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

total.description: How many items the whole list has, or null when the operation does not count them.

items.description: The items on this page, in the list's order.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

total.description: How many items the whole list has, or null when the operation does not count them.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the code is the error's identity.

title.description: The HTTP reason phrase, such as `Not Found`.

detail.description: An English message safe to show to the user.

code.description: The snake_case error code; x-orvano-error-codes lists every code.

errors.description: On `validation_failed`: each field that is not valid.

retryAfter.description: On a 429 or a 503 that knows when to come back: seconds to wait, equal to `Retry-After`.

requiredRole.description: On a console 403: the console role that would allow the action.

currentVersion.description: On `version_conflict`: the resource's current version, as its `ETag` without quotes.

supportedVersions.description: On `unsupported_api_version`: the versions the server serves.

Problem.description: The error body of every non 2xx response (RFC 9457 problem details). `code` identifies the error.

status.description: Where it is in its lifecycle. Only an active project reaches the data plane.

allowedOrigins.description: The exact browser origins it accepts.

allowedActions.description: The console permissions the operator holds on it.

ProjectStatus.description: A project's lifecycle (spec 0011 LIF, TXN-1). Only ProjectStatus.Active reaches the data plane (LIF-4).

memberships.description: The first 100 organizations by id. Anything that needs every organization uses the paged list.

csrfToken.description: What state changing requests send as `Orvano-Csrf`.

expiresAt.description: When the session ends, however busy it is.

SessionResponse.description: The signed in operator and their session.

token.description: The token the setup page accepted.

SetupOwnerRequest.description: The first owner, their organization, and the proof of a setup token.

token.description: The token from the setup link or from `orvano admin setup-token`; surrounding spaces are ignored.

email.description: The account's email; case and surrounding spaces don't matter.

SignInRequest.description: An email and password to sign in with.

Authorization.name: Authorization
Authorization.description: `Bearer <access token>` for a signed in end user.

Idempotency-Key.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency-Key.description: 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters that make a retried request safe, on operations marked `x-orvano-idempotent`.

If-Match.name: If-Match
If-Match.description: The `ETag` of the version you read. A write to a changed resource answers `412 version_conflict`.

Orvano-Api-Version.name: Orvano-Api-Version
Orvano-Api-Version.description: The API version the client was built for, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Without it the server uses its current version.

Orvano-Client.name: Orvano-Client
Orvano-Client.description: The SDK and its version, `<package>/<version>`. Used for telemetry only.

Orvano-Csrf.name: Orvano-Csrf
Orvano-Csrf.description: The console session's CSRF token, on requests that change state.

Orvano-Key.name: Orvano-Key
Orvano-Key.description: The project's publishable (`orv_pk_…`) or secret (`orv_sk_…`) key.

traceparent.name: traceparent
traceparent.description: W3C trace context, to join the request to your trace.

ETag.description: The strong ETag of the resource's version. Send it back as `If-Match` to write safely.

Orvano-Api-Version.description: The API version the server answered with.

Orvano-Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when the answer is a replay of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

Orvano-Request-Id.description: The request's 32 hex character trace ID. Equals the problem body's `traceId`; quote it when you report an issue.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, on a 429 or a 503 that knows when to come back.
